sql:
SELECT month_of_half, half,
       ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (PARTITION BY half ORDER BY month_of_half), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM (
  SELECT CAST((CAST(strftime('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) - 1) % 6 + 1 AS TEXT) AS month_of_half,

  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on >= '2025-01-01'

)
ORDER BY half, month_of_half

the columns are month_of_half, half and cumulative_eur, the euro figure last

plan.title: Veraenderung zum Vormonat seit dem Sommer

sql:
SELECT month, ROUND(spent - prev, 2) AS change_eur
FROM (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
         -SUM(amount) AS spent,
         LAG(-SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on)) AS prev
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on >= '2025-05-01'
  GROUP BY month
)
WHERE prev IS NOT NULL AND month >= '2025-06'
ORDER BY month

the columns are month and change_eur, and change_eur holds the numbers and keeps its sign
